title: A perturbative action for closed-string fields
statement: Construct a gauge-consistent closed bosonic string-field action reproducing worldsheet sewing perturbatively. Ghosts, BRST state space and the quantum BV master equation specify an operational reconstruction of the broader loop-functional integral request.
status: As of November 2026, \citet[abstract and sections 3--4]{zwiebach1993closed} supplies the perturbative BV sewing action: preprint June 1992, publication 1993. The match is partial; no convergent nonperturbative loop-functional measure follows, and no separate open measure problem is invented.

title: An explicit proof of the projective bundle construction
statement: Prove the BGG bundle existence theorem through explicit exterior modules and complexes without using derived equivalence as a black box. This operational interpretation is not a formal prohibition on all homological algebra.
status: As of November 2026, \citet[Theorems 4.1 and 6.1]{eisenbudfloystadschreyer2003exterior} and \citet[Theorem 2.2]{coandatrautmann2003horrocks} substantially meet the constructive aim. Complete categorical elimination is not certified. Related GP-1979-03 occurs at 1979-468.14; GP-1977-11 includes 1977-437.2, 1977-437.11, 1977-438.5 and 1979-468.13. These questions are not silently merged.

title: Equations and degrees of Segre hyperdeterminants
statement: For a nontrivial complex Segre embedding, determine when the dual is a hypersurface, construct its reduced equation and calculate its degree, including binary and boundary formats. Tensor side lengths are projective dimensions plus one; the scalar case has a separate affine convention.
status: As of November 2026, these Segre questions are established. The criterion has the earlier Knop--Menzel 1987 antecedent, explicitly credited after Corollary 2 in GKZ section 6. The degree series, positive formula and boundary formula appear in the 1989 joint paper, received 13 December 1988. This does not assert efficient expansion of every large-format polynomial. See \citet[section 6, Theorem 2 and Corollaries 1--3]{gelfandzelevinskykapranov1989dual}.

title: Discriminants as determinants of Cayley--Koszul complexes
statement: Construct finite section-linear complexes detecting singular hyperplane sections and yielding the discriminant, with smoothness, positivity, twist, determinant-line, multiplicity, acyclic-chart and dual-defect conventions specified. Distinguish regular and logarithmic toric constructions.
status: As of November 2026, the first-jet construction and Segre specialization are identified in \citet[sections 2--3 and 5]{gelfandzelevinskykapranov1989dual}. The subsequent \citet[sections 4--5]{gelfandzelevinskykapranov1989cayley}, received June 1989, distinguishes discriminants and principal determinants; its English translation appeared in 1990. The notebook local differential needs a sign correction, and its specific minor matrices remain incomplete.

title: Completeness of geometric integrals in Clebsch hydrodynamics
statement: Do integrals built from smooth periodic single-valued Clebsch labels and their iterated Poisson brackets, even supplemented by a fixed lambda field, determine mu sufficiently for the proposed reconstruction?
status: As of November 2026, no in general. Area-preserving spatial relabelings generated by a function of lambda preserve lambda and the geometric integrals while changing generic mu. \citet[sections 2--3]{zakharov1989clebsch} gives the exact obstruction; submitted 2 November 1988, published in the 1989 issue. This is incompleteness of a specified family, not universal nonintegrability of Euler flow.

title: The critical three-dimensional Ising continuum problem
statement: Obtain a continuum description and critical thermal behaviour from the recorded fermion/surface programme. A stronger editorial target asks for convergence of normalized smeared spin and centered energy observables in the critical zero-field nearest-neighbour ferromagnetic model on Z3, with identified correlation scaling and justified thermal relations.
status: As of November 2026, no checked primary source proves the full target. \citet[section 8.4]{duminilcopin2022hundred} distinguishes bootstrap data from lattice convergence. The 2026 string paper treats a gapped regime; the complete certified-exponent claim was not independently audited and is not a field-convergence theorem. The present development supplies proved finite identities and computations without claiming new continuum progress.

title: The dual of a quasi-Hopf algebra
statement: Identify the dual structure and necessary finiteness or topology. In finite dimension, the dual has coassociative coproduct and quasiassociative multiplication, with the associator transposed to a convolution-invertible scalar reassociator.
status: As of November 2026, finite-dimensional coquasi-Hopf duality is established in \citet[sections 2--3]{schauenburg2004two}, preprint 2002 and publication 2004. An infinite-dimensional full dual needs restricted-dual or completion choices absent from the notes.
